purpose: ground truth for the phase 6 REA tool-use benchmark (issue #23 part C), committed BEFORE any run

binary.note: builds differ in the PE timestamp, so the exact binary used is committed

tasks.question: In the function rb_crc, which 32-bit polynomial constant is used? Answer in hex.
The function rb_mix multiplies by two constants. What is the FIRST multiplier (the one applied first)? Answer in hex.
The function rb_unmask XORs a buffer with a single-byte key. What is the key? Answer in hex.
What does the function rb_pop compute? Choose one: popcount, parity, bit-reverse, leading-zero-count, byte-swap.
tasks.truth: bench.c rb_pop: while (x) { x &= x - 1; n++; }

tasks.question: What does the function rb_gcd compute? Choose one: gcd, lcm, factorial, is-prime, modular-power.
The function rb_login compares a password with a hard-coded string. What is that password string?
Which function whose name starts with rb_ calls strcmp? Answer with the function name only.
tasks.truth: bench.c: of the rb_ functions only rb_login calls strcmp (main calls it too, which is why the question says rb_)

tasks.question: Which function XORs every byte of a buffer with one constant value in a loop? Consider only functions whose name starts with rb_. Answer with the function name only.
Which function uses the constant 0x9E3779B9 (the golden-ratio multiplier)? Consider only functions whose name starts with rb_. Answer with the function name only.
Does the program import any networking (socket) functions? Answer yes or no.
tasks.truth: bench.exe imports WSAStartup, socket, closesocket from WS2_32.dll

tasks.question: From which DLL does the program import WSAStartup? Answer with the DLL name.
tasks.truth: objdump -p bench.exe: DLL Name WS2_32.dll lists WSAStartup

tasks.question: Which imported C-runtime function writes a block of raw bytes (buffer, element size, count) to a FILE stream? Answer with the function name only.
tasks.truth: objdump -p bench.exe: msvcrt.dll imports fwrite (and fprintf, vfprintf, fopen, fclose, printf, strcmp)

tasks.question: What is the RVA of this PE file's import directory? Answer in hex (decimal is accepted too).
tasks.truth: PE optional header data directory 1 of the committed bin/bench.exe: RVA 0x18000 (98304), size 4160
